data.cultural_impact: In Hindu culture, strength and power are highly valued traits, and the name Kivanth reflects this cultural emphasis on these qualities. Kivanth is a name that brings to mind the legendary figure of Lord Hanuman, who is known for his immense strength, courage, and unwavering devotion to his Lord Rama. Just as Lord Hanuman served Lord Rama and helped him both in battle and in personal struggles, the name Kivanth inspires individuals to use their inner strength and power to overcome challenges and live a fulfilling, purposeful life.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Kivanth is deeply meaningful as it reminds individuals of the presence and power of their divine inner self. The name Kivanth invokes the spirit of Lord Hanuman, who embodies the pure, unwavering devotion to God and the infinite strength to carry out His will. By embracing the name Kivanth, individuals are reminded of their own inner divine essence, and are inspired to live their lives in accordance with this spiritual truth, drawing upon their inner strength to face any challenges or adversities that may come their way.

historical_references.reference: The name Kivanth is mentioned in the ancient Hindu epic Mahabharata. It is the name of a demon, Kivanta, who was slain by the great warrior Bhima.
historical_references.context: Mahabharata is an Indian epic that narrates the Kurukshetra War between the Pandava and Kaurava princes. Kivanta was a demon and an ally of the Kauravas. Bhima, one of the Pandava brothers, killed him during the war.

historical_references.reference: Another reference to the name Kivanth can be found in the Puranic texts, specifically the Shiva Purana. In this context, Kivanth is the name of a sage who is the son of King Vibhishaana, the loyal brother of the demon king Ravana.
historical_references.context: Puranas are Hindu religious texts that contain mythology, philosophy, and various other topics. The Shiva Purana is one of the eighteen major Puranas. In this text, Kivanth is a sage and a devotee of Lord Shiva.

modern_usage.modern_context: In today's interconnected world, the name Kivanth continues to be cherished by Hindu families globally. It is frequently featured on social media platforms where parents share their naming journeys, and Hindu name websites where expectant parents research meaningful names. The name bridges traditional Hindu values with modern Indian identity, making it relevant for contemporary families seeking names with deep spiritual and cultural significance.
